changelog:
### VietLab v1.0.2 - Toi uu hoa bo cai dat & Nang cap trai nghiem giam sat

- Toi uu quy trinh cai dat Client: Phuc vu truc tiep bo cai dat Inno Setup (.exe) qua Cong thong tin web LAN, loai bo cac thao tac script phuc tap.
- Cong thong tin hoc sinh tinh gon, hien dai: Tich hop tai bo cai, trao doi voi giao vien (gio tay, nhan tin) va tai lieu bai hoc truc quan.
- Client bo sung menu va loi tat: Nhap dup vao icon khay he thong hoac menu chuot phai de mo nhanh Cong thong tin.
- Trang Cai dat mo rong full-width tran vien, dong bo trai nghiem nguoi dung.
- Giam sat truc tiep thoi gian thuc: Thong bao popup khi may con ket noi, mat ket noi, gio tay, nhan tin; ho tro gui tin nhan nhanh toi tung may hoac toan phong.
- Nang cap dieu khien tu xa toan man hinh va hien thi chinh xac toa do chuot tren may con.
